title: fr-decomposition widget params
description: The decomposition and inertia groups at a prime P above p in a Galois extension K/Q. Steppers set the ramification index e, residue degree f, and number of primes r (so |G|=n=efr). The widget draws the fixed-field tower Q ⊆ K^D ⊆ K^I ⊆ K with step degrees r (decomposition: p splits into r), f (residue/Frobenius), and e (inertia/ramification), alongside the short exact sequence 1→I→D→Gal(F_{p^f}/F_p)→1 with |D|=ef=|G|/r (orbit–stabiliser), |I|=e, and D/I≅Z/f where Frobenius lives. At an unramified prime e=1, so I is trivial and D is cyclic of order f generated by Frobenius.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper.
